local scn, done = ...
local function crate(pos, ang)
  local e = ents.Create("prop_physics") e:SetModel("models/props_junk/wood_crate001a.mdl")
  e:SetPos(pos) e:SetAngles(ang or Angle(0,0,0)) e:Spawn() e:Activate()
  local p = e:GetPhysicsObject() p:EnableGravity(false) p:Wake() return e
end
for _, e in ipairs(ents.FindByClass("prop_physics")) do e:Remove() end
local k = crate(Vector(500, -500, -60), Angle(30, 0, 0))      -- pitch 30, ref Angle(0,0,0)
local k2 = crate(Vector(300, -500, -60), Angle(0, 0, 60))     -- roll 60
local k3 = crate(Vector(200, -500, -60), Angle(30, 45, 0))    -- pitch 30 yaw 45, ref = own angles (what a "keep upright" of the current pose does)
local k4 = crate(Vector(100, -500, -60), Angle(0, 0, 60))     -- roll 60 with angularlimit 60 (slow)
local samples, t = {}, 0
hook.Add("Think", "parity_lua_effects3", function()
  t = t + 1
  if t == 60 then
    k.upright = constraint.Keepupright(k, Angle(0, 0, 0), 0, 999999)
    k2.upright = constraint.Keepupright(k2, Angle(0, 0, 0), 0, 999999)
    k3.upright = constraint.Keepupright(k3, k3:GetAngles(), 0, 999999)
    k4.upright = constraint.Keepupright(k4, Angle(0, 0, 0), 0, 60)
    for _, e in ipairs({k, k2, k3, k4}) do e:GetPhysicsObject():Wake() e:GetPhysicsObject():SetVelocity(Vector(0,0,1)) end
  end
  if t == 120 then  -- tip k3 after it is "kept upright": roll it by 40 degrees via angular velocity
    k3:GetPhysicsObject():AddAngleVelocity(Vector(0, 0, 0))
    k3:SetAngles(k3:GetAngles() + Angle(0, 0, 40)) k3:GetPhysicsObject():Wake()
    k:SetAngles(Angle(30, 0, 20)) k:GetPhysicsObject():Wake()
  end
  if t >= 58 and t <= 200 then
    local function A(e) local a = e:GetAngles() return { a.p, a.y, a.r } end
    samples[#samples + 1] = { t = t, k = A(k), k2 = A(k2), k3 = A(k3), k4 = A(k4), kw = k:GetPhysicsObject():GetAngleVelocity().y }
  end
  if t == 201 then hook.Remove("Think", "parity_lua_effects3") done({ samples = samples }) end
end)
return "async"
